Spot checks per batch: meeting parts 4-6, 9 and 12-13, small talk 0 and 4, ending 6, 9 and 15, going home bands 0, 1-2 and 3; a park-0 date with both options and two notes; Kirameki Park's pond version with all options (spring event suppressed via 0x800E67EF); one Shopping path; Bowling, Beach, Karaoke (all options), Zoo, Aquarium, Planetarium, Stadium and two Arcade versions; the Cinema announcement, a Concert Hall choice and reply, the Shrine's yukata choice with both options; the Theme Park's three rides with their choices and replies. Checked only statically (structure, width, packing): the other versions, branches and moods, the Arcade's video/medal action choice, the Shrine after the goldfish minigame, the Theme Park hero show and the parade (not reached), and all natural triggers. The impression thoughts after each choice (SERIFU.BIN) and the outing description thoughts are other files and still Japanese.
